the pilot study is finished but the results are still provisional we invited twenty people and received thirteen complete responses plus two partial ones i don't want to combine those counts because the partial responses are missing the questions about usability the note from the interviewer says in double quotes most people seemed comfortable close quotes but that is an impression rather than a measured result new paragraph before we share the report the checks are one verify which participants completed the full task two compare the recorded times with the original notes three mark unanswered questions as missing end of list please don't replace missing values with zero because that would change the meaning of the measurements we also need to keep the comment from the participant who found the instructions confusing even though most other comments were positive on another topic we have not decided whether to repeat the study with a different group i think that would be useful but it is a recommendation not an approved plan the remaining budget is three hundred rupees and i don't know whether that covers another session so don't add a date or promise any further recruitment yet

The pilot study is finished, but the results are still provisional. We invited 20 people and received 13 complete responses plus two partial ones. I don't want to combine those counts because the partial responses are missing the questions about usability. The note from the interviewer says "most people seemed comfortable," but that is an impression rather than a measured result.

Before we share the report, the checks are:

1. Verify which participants completed the full task.
2. Compare the recorded times with the original notes.
3. Mark unanswered questions as missing.

Please don't replace missing values with zero because that would change the meaning of the measurements. We also need to keep the comment from the participant who found the instructions confusing even though most other comments were positive.

On another topic, we have not decided whether to repeat the study with a different group. I think that would be useful, but it is a recommendation, not an approved plan. The remaining budget is ₹300, and I don't know whether that covers another session, so don't add a date or promise any further recruitment yet.

1. Load the same test file.
2. Record the response time.
3. Repeat the request without changing the settings.
